mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, display_name, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM admin_user
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user (username, password_hash, display_name, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_user SET username = #{username}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, display_name = #{displayName}, enabled = #{enabled}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
